self_intersections.method: All triangle pairs with overlapping AABBs; noncoplanar plane-cut intervals and coplanar 2-D polygon intersections. Shared mesh edge/vertex contact is permitted.
self_intersections.limitation: Floating-point geometric screening, not a formal exact-arithmetic certificate.

sections.method: Actual horizontal mesh intersections at layer midpoints; 2-D material parity; previous-layer buffered support envelope.
sections.feature_screen_method: Erode each material section by half feature width; report empty or disconnected core. No universal 3-D thickness guarantee.
limitations: Sampled sections can miss features narrower in Z than the layer spacing.
Support test is a 45-degree style geometric envelope, not extrusion or bridge simulation.
Erosion detects missing/disconnected section cores, but attached thin protrusions may survive this screen unnoticed.
No nozzle path generation, adhesion, cooling, material shrinkage or physical print tested.
